mission: Review failed deliveries before another attempt.
why_it_exists: Blind retries can spend resources without fixing the cause.
design_decisions: The optional GCP profile has a bounded model budget.
known_limits: A verdict cannot dispatch a courier or change stock.

tool_descriptions.judge.read: Inspect failed delivery evidence and recovery candidates.
tool_descriptions.judge.review: Approve or reject a proposed recovery; cannot dispatch it.
tool_descriptions.memory.read: Recall evidence inside the current run, role and order scope.
tool_descriptions.memory.write: Append a bounded memory observation with provenance.
tool_descriptions.queue.publish: Publish an allowed topic to a permitted recipient.
